snippet.description:
What if the biggest problem in your UPSC preparation isn’t working hard, but knowing when to change your approach?

AIR 100 Satwik Satyakam Devta took six UPSC attempts and appeared in Mains six times. His journey involved plenty of trial, error and learning what actually works.

In this special strategy session, Satwik shares the preparation lessons he wishes he had known earlier: choosing the right sources, building a practical study system, avoiding ineffective habits and adapting your strategy instead of blindly sticking to it.

If you’re starting UPSC preparation, this is a session worth watching before you build your routine.

Meet us - 📍Location: LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh Centre; Google Map - https://maps.app.goo.gl/6brt5mwLSFhENRCq8
Address - 2nd Floor, 45 Pusa Road, Opp. Metro Pillar 128, Karol Bagh
